verdict.rationale: A processor has no data-training policy of its own, but AMD's GAIA framework for this hardware runs AI agents locally by default. AMD says local inference keeps data private and supports air-gapped deployment, so user data need not leave the device. The broader Ryzen AI stack also runs models on-device through ONNX Runtime, Lemonade and llama.cpp. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement or opt-out control covering use of user data for model training, coverage of the whole software stack beyond GAIA, and independent corroboration.
